name: Dragonpulse Magician
extDescription:
Pendulum Effect : Once per turn, if you have a "Magician" card in your other Pendulum Zone: You can discard 1 Pendulum Monster, then target 1 face-up monster on the field; destroy it.
Monster Text : A young novice magician whose redeeming feature is his boundless energy. In fact he has the ability to unconsciously perceive the souls of the dragons sleeping inside the earth. While he's still half baked as a magician, his master, "Dragonpit Magician" could easily tell he was a master magician in the making from merely a glance.

name: Dragonpit Magician
extDescription:
Pendulum Effect :Once per turn, if you have a "Magician" card in your other Pendulum Zone: You can discard 1 Pendulum Monster, then target 1 Spell/Trap Card on the field; destroy it.
Monster Text : This gifted magician can awaken the energy stored in the deep places of the earth, known as the Pits of the Dragon. His stoic approach wins him few friends, and he often bends to the desires of his pupil.

name: Nobledragon Magician
extDescription:
Pendulum Effect :If you have no "Magician" cards in your other Pendulum Zone, destroy this card.
Monster Text :If this card is in your hand or Graveyard: You can target 1 Level 7 or higher "Odd-Eyes" monster you control; reduce its Level by 3, and if you do, Special Summon this card. Cannot be used as a Synchro Material, except for the Synchro Summon of a Dragon-Type Synchro Monster. If this card is used for a Synchro Summon, and the other Synchro Material(s) is not an "Odd-Eyes" monster, place this card on the bottom of the Deck.

name: Oafdragon Magician
extDescription:
Pendulum Effect :If you have a "Magician" card in your other Pendulum Zone: You can add 1 face-up "Magician" or "Odd-Eyes" Pendulum Monster from your Extra Deck to your hand, except "Oafdragon Magician". You can only use this effect of "Oafdragon Magician" once per turn.
Monster Text :If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 "Magician" Pendulum Monster or 1 "Odd-Eyes" monster in your Graveyard, except "Oafdragon Magician"; add it to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Oafdragon Magician" once per turn.

name: Wisdom-Eye Magician
extDescription:
Pendulum Effect :If you have a "Magician" or "Performapal" card in your other Pendulum Zone: You can destroy this card, and if you do, place 1 "Magician" Pendulum Monster from your Deck in your Pendulum Zone, except "Wisdom-Eye Magician".
Monster Text :You can discard this card, then target 1 card in your Pendulum Zone whose current Pendulum Scale is different from its original value; its Pendulum Scale becomes its original value until the end of this turn.

name: Performapal Skullcrobat Joker
extDescription:
Pendulum Effect :You cannot Pendulum Summon monsters, except "Performapal" monsters, "Magician" Pendulum Monsters, and "Odd-Eyes" monsters. This effect cannot be negated.
Monster Text :When this card is Normal Summoned: You can add 1 "Performapal" monster, 1 "Magician" Pendulum Monster, or 1 "Odd-Eyes" monster from your Deck to your hand, except "Performapal Skullcrobat Joker".

name: Stargazer Magician
extDescription:
Pendulum Effect :If a Pendulum Monster you control attacks or is attacked, your opponent cannot activate Spell Cards until the end of the Damage Step. Unless you have a "Magician" card or "Odd-Eyes" card in your other Pendulum Zone, this card's Pendulum Scale becomes 4.
Monster Text :Once per turn, when exactly 1 other Pendulum Monster you control (and no other cards) is returned to your hand by an opponent's card effect (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon 1 monster from your hand with the same name as that returned to the hand.

name: Timegazer Magician
extDescription:
Pendulum Effect :You must control no monsters to activate this card. If a Pendulum Monster you control attacks or is attacked, your opponent cannot activate Trap Cards until the end of the Damage Step. Unless you have a "Magician" card or "Odd-Eyes" card in your other Pendulum Zone, this card's Pendulum Scale becomes 4.
Monster Text :Each turn, the first card(s) in your Pendulum Zone that would be destroyed by an opponent's card effect, is not destroyed.

name: Odd-Eyes Pendulum Dragon
extDescription:
Pendulum Effect :You can reduce the battle damage you take from an attack involving a Pendulum Monster you control to 0. During your End Phase: You can destroy this card, and if you do, add 1 Pendulum Monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck to your hand. You can only use each Pendulum Effect of "Odd-Eyes Pendulum Dragon" once per turn.
Monster Text :If this card battles an opponent's monster, any battle damage this card inflicts to your opponent is doubled.

name: Performapal Silver Claw
extDescription:
Pendulum Effect :All "Performapal" monsters you control gain 300 ATK.
Monster Text :If this card declares an attack: All "Performapal" monsters you currently control gain 300 ATK until the end of the Battle Phase.

name: Performapal Salutiger
extDescription: When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: You can add 1 "Performapal" Pendulum Monster from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Performapal Salutiger" once per turn.

name: Performapal Trump Witch
extDescription:
Pendulum Effect : Once per turn: You can Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters you control as Fusion Materials.
Monster Effect : You can Tribute this card; add 1 "Polymerization" from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand.

name: Metaphys Armed Dragon
extDescription: Usually visible despite its phantom existence.

name: Fusilier Dragon, the Dual-Mode Beast
cleanName: Fusilier Dragon the Dual Mode Beast
extDescription: You can Normal Summon or Set this card without Tributing. If you do, its original ATK and DEF are halved.

name: Chaos Hunter
extDescription: When your opponent Special Summons a monster (except during the Damage Step): You can discard 1 card; Special Summon this card from your hand. Your opponent cannot banish cards.

name: Lyla, Lightsworn Sorceress
extDescription: You can target 1 Spell/Trap Card your opponent controls; this card's battle position cannot be changed until the end of your next turn, also change this card you control from face-up Attack Position to face-up Defense Position, and if you do, destroy that target. During each of your End Phases: Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard.

name: Fencing Fire Ferret
extDescription: If this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; destroy that target, and if you do, inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

name: Inari Fire
extDescription: You can only control 1 face-up "Inari Fire". If you control a Spellcaster-Type monster, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). During your next Standby Phase after this face-up card on the field was destroyed by a card effect and sent to the Graveyard: Special Summon it from your Graveyard.

name: Nefarious Archfiend Eater of Nefariousness
extDescription: You can only control 1 "Nefarious Archfiend Eater of Nefariousness". If you control a Spellcaster-Type monster, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). During your opponent's End Phase, if this card is in your Graveyard: You can target 1 face-up monster you control; destroy it, and if you do, Special Summon this card.

name: Jigabyte
extDescription: You can only control 1 "Jigabyte". If you control a Spellcaster-Type monster, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). When this card is destroyed by battle or card effect and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 monster with 1500 ATK and 200 DEF from your Deck, except "Jigabyte".

name: Goblindbergh
extDescription: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower monster from your hand, then change this card to Defense Position if you activated this effect.

name: X-Saber Airbellum
extDescription: If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent by a direct attack: Discard 1 random card from your opponent's hand.

name: Magna Drago
extDescription: Each time this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, it gains 200 ATK.

name: Re-Cover
extDescription: If this card is in the Graveyard and your opponent has 5 or more cards in their Extra Deck than you do: You can pay 2000 LP; Special Summon this card, and if you do, banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use this effect of "Re-Cover" once per turn.

name: Sky Iris
extDescription: Your opponent cannot target "Magician", "Performapal", and "Odd-Eyes" cards in your Pendulum Zones with card effects. You can target 1 other face-up card you control; destroy it, and if you do, add 1 "Odd-Eyes" card from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Sky Iris" once per turn.

name: Pendulum Call
extDescription: Discard 1 card; add 2 "Magician" Pendulum Monsters with different names from your Deck to your hand. Until the end of your opponent's next turn after this card resolves, "Magician" cards in your Pendulum Zones cannot be destroyed by card effects. You can only activate 1 "Pendulum Call" per turn. You cannot activate this card if you activated the Pendulum Effect of a "Magician" Pendulum Monster this turn.

name: Pendulum Shift
extDescription: Target 1 card in either player's Pendulum Zone, and declare a Pendulum Scale from 1 to 10; this turn, that card becomes that Pendulum Scale.

name: Pendulum Rising
extDescription: Send 1 monster you control to the Graveyard; Special Summon from your Main Deck, 1 Pendulum Monster with the same Level as the sent monster's original Level, but destroy it during the End Phase. You can only activate 1 "Pendulum Rising" per turn.

name: Sacred Sword of Seven Stars
extDescription: Banish 1 Level 7 monster from your hand or face-up from your side of the field; draw 2 cards. You can only activate 1 "Sacred Sword of Seven Stars" per turn.

name: Summoner's Art
extDescription: Add 1 Level 5 or higher Normal Monster from your Deck to your hand.

name: Mystical Space Typhoon
extDescription: Target 1 Spell/Trap Card on the field; destroy that target.

name: Scapegoat
extDescription: Special Summon 4 "Sheep Tokens" (Beast-Type/EARTH/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) in Defense Position. These Tokens cannot be Tributed for a Tribute Summon. You cannot Summon other monsters the turn you activate this card (but you can Normal Set).

name: Forbidden Dress
extDescription: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; until the end of this turn, that target loses 600 ATK, but cannot be targeted or destroyed by other card effects.

name: Polymerization
extDescription: Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or your side of the field as Fusion Materials.

name: Terraforming
extDescription: Add 1 Field Spell Card from your Deck to your hand.

name: Pendulum Back
extDescription: If you have 2 cards in your Pendulum Zones: Target 2 monsters in your Graveyard, each with a Level between (exclusive) the Pendulum Scales of the cards in your Pendulum Zones; add them to your hand.

name: Powerful Rebirth
extDescription: Activate this card by targeting 1 Level 4 or lower monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target. Its Level is increased by 1 and ATK and DEF by 100. When that monster is destroyed, destroy this card.

name: Traptrix Trap Hole Nightmare
extDescription: When a monster that was Special Summoned this turn activates its effect on your opponent's side of the field: Negate that effect, and if you do, destroy that card.

name: Torrential Tribute
extDescription: When a monster(s) is Summoned: Destroy all monsters on the field.

name: Eradicator Epidemic Virus
extDescription: Tribute 1 DARK monster with 2500 or more ATK, and choose Spell Cards or Trap Cards; check your opponent's hand, all Spell/Trap Cards they control, and all cards they draw until the end of their 3rd turn after this card's activation, and destroy all cards of the chosen type.

name: Odd-Eyes Meteorburst Dragon
extDescription:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
When this card is Special Summoned: You can target 1 card in your Pendulum Zone; Special Summon it, but this card cannot attack for the rest of this turn. You can only use this effect of "Odd-Eyes Meteorburst Dragon" once per turn. Monsters in your opponent's possession cannot activate their effects during the Battle Phase.

name: Odd-Eyes Absolute Dragon
extDescription:
2 Level 7 monsters
When any player's monster declares an attack: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; negate the attack, then you can Special Summon 1 "Odd-Eyes" monster from your hand or Graveyard. If this Xyz Summoned card is sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 "Odd-Eyes" monster from your Extra Deck, except "Odd-Eyes Absolute Dragon". You can only use each effect of "Odd-Eyes Absolute Dragon" once per turn.

name: Rune-Eyes Pendulum Dragon
extDescription:
"Odd-Eyes Pendulum Dragon" + 1 Spellcaster-Type monster
If this card was Fusion Summoned using a Pendulum Summoned monster(s) on the field as Fusion Material, it is unaffected by your opponent's card effects this turn. Apply the appropriate effect, depending on the original Level of the monster used as Fusion Material that was not "Odd-Eyes Pendulum Dragon".
- Level 4 or lower: This card can make up to 2 attacks on monsters during each Battle Phase.
- Level 5 or higher: This card can make up to 3 attacks on monsters during each Battle Phase.
